message.content: My shell takes 1.8 seconds to start. Profile it.

content.text: zprof shows nvm init at 1.2 s and compinit at 0.3 s. Lazy-loading nvm and caching the completion dump brings startup to 140 ms.

message.content: Keep the cache fresh when I add plugins.

content.text: compinit now rebuilds the dump only when it is older than a day or the plugin list changed.
